## Upload

Write the file `tilbakemelding-<id>.md` in the current folder, show me its content, then run exactly this one command (on Windows use `curl.exe` instead of `curl`):

```bash
curl -sS --data-binary @tilbakemelding-<id>.md https://survey.metapol.no/api/submit
```

The server answers in one line of plain text:
- "Takk for tilbakemeldingen!" or "Kallenavnet ... er registrert": tell me it was sent.
- "Kallenavnet ... finnes allerede ...": tell me exactly that, and ask whether that nickname is mine. If not, ask for a new nickname and upload again with a new id.
- "Ugyldig svar: ..." or "Ugyldig kallenavn: ...": the message names the field. Ask me that one question again, fix the file and upload once more.
- "Ugyldig eller utløpt nøkkel": tell me the survey is closed and that I can give the file to the course lead.
- "For mange innsendinger ...": wait one minute and upload once more.
- A network error such as "Could not resolve host": your sandbox is probably blocking the network. Run the same command once more and ask for permission to run it outside the sandbox (with network access).
- If it still fails, tell me in Norwegian that the upload failed and that I can send the file `tilbakemelding-<id>.md` to the course lead instead.
